docs.text: clear skies tonight as sun set behind our Easterly plant over frozen Lake Erie. weather report from plant operator Tim Reading a few hours ago: “5° and dead quiet since it’s all ice.” cold. dangerous. beautiful. stay safe out there, Tim, and thank you for your work.

There's a nice 'reverse' lake cloud-only plume this morning over Lake Erie. The inversion is quite low (near 925 mb), but below that it's cold and buoyant. Shown here is GOES-16 1-minute data using CIRA's GeoColor. col.st/bhXAr

Great Lakes make great clouds
#cyclingohio south of Lake Erie this AM

Great patience by you to get those shots with all those clouds! Our local news weather guy showed time lapse video from the satellite with just streaming clouds pouring off Lake Michigan here! I am sure Lake Erie is doing the same there! Glad you saw the comet!

The clouds cleared just in time for the sun to put on a show tonight over Lake Erie. Shifting wind directions shoved fresh ice chunks back onto shore today. These nights of fire over ice are dwindling as our big ice cube continues to melt away and winter nears it end. #NYwx
Just re-checked the radar map and a new big chunk of cloud has materialized over Lake Erie. Ugh! Still hoping we get lucky! ❌☁️❌
Just an absolute wall of clouds rolling off of Lake Erie tonight.

Did you happen to hear reports of a roll cloud between ~Angola & ~Westfield? I've never seen a roll cloud so I can't say what I saw, but I followed a cloud line coming off Lake Erie for at least 10 miles along I-90. Looked to be rolling, but I was driving. Nothing on radar.
We are just over 3k of observations so far this week for #cropmap25. Today we stay close to the Lake Erie shoreline down to Harrow before heading north under Lake St Clair to Sarnia. #ontag #cdnag
We reserved in Port Clinton, OH, several months ago. It's on Lake Erie, and there's supposed to be less chance of clouds on the Great Lakes, but the forecast isn't great.

Clouds will hamper viewing of the #Orionid Meteor Shower the next few nights as a strong low pressure system moves across the Great Lakes Region. If you want to take a chance at seeing them, get away from city lights and look into the southeastern sky after midnight.

One month to go! Proximity to the lake may impact cloud cover for the eclipse. Below are clear sky & overcast charts for 3pm in April for Erie & Meadville. Erie tends to be cloudier but has a better chance of clear sky if T <40°. Safe to say there won't be ice on Lake Erie.
Cloud cover over Lake Erie doesn't look like it wants to clear up any time soon. ☁️☁️☁️ #eclipse #totality
There are clouds forecast for the entire north shore of Lake Erie 😭

Visible satellite this afternoon gives us a good view of the pesky lake-effect clouds in some areas (even some lingering flurries), widespread snow cover in others. Look carefully for ice on western end of Lake Erie, although ice coverage is still behind schedule.
Big cloud cover south of Lake Erie right now! But clear skies are coming from the west over the next 6 hours. Heads up for potential frost overnight as temperatures drop into the 30s.
